description: A regular expression from a description, with examples that must match and examples that must not. The pattern is returned only when every example passes when tested in the service (one retry with the failures). Patterns with nested quantifiers are refused to avoid catastrophic backtracking. Examples are up to 10 strings of 300 characters each. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

description.description: What the pattern should match, in plain words (max 500 characters)

matches.description: Strings the pattern must match (1-10 items, each max 300 characters)

nonMatches.description: Strings the pattern must not match (0-10 items, each max 300 characters)
